Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can choose different Digimon for each of the effects. You can choose the same Digimon or different ones.
Card Q&A.q: Can I choose different Digimon for this card's effect to get +2000 DP and gain ?

Effect: [Main] 1 of your Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn. Then, if you have a Digimon with [Huckmon] in its name or [Royal Knight] in its traits in play, gain 1 memory, and 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
Security Effect: [Security] Gain 1 memory, and add this card to its owner's hand.
